title: Buggy Samsung : Using workaround
body:
I have a Samsung J3 20F. I can not connect the blucon with the XDrip. At the bluetooth scan it finds the blucon but it always stays not connected. I have unistall the Xdrip and install an other version but it still can not connect with the blucon. At the Bluetooth Collector Status it shows a green message "Buggy Samsung : Using workaround"

I have to say that i tried the bluecon to another mobile with the  same version of Xdrip and it was working great. 

Could someone tell what is going on with the Samsung ? Thank you very much
